SEARCH
Package com.splunk

Class HttpService

java.lang.Object
com.splunk.HttpService
Direct Known Subclasses:
Service
public class HttpService extends Object
The HttpService class represents a generic HTTP service at a given address (host:port), accessed using a given protocol scheme (http or https).

    • sslSecurityProtocol

    • validateCertificates

      protected static boolean validateCertificates
      Boolean flag for validating certificates at either of the sides (client/server). If true, then it will check and validate relevant certificates otherwise, in case of false, it will accept all certificates. For PROD environment, TRUE is strongly recommended, whereas working in localhost OR development environment, FALSE is used. Default Value: TRUE
